segments.evidence: The sales of diversified pharmaceutical and allied products, AI Solutions and Insurance Business accounted for 62%, 9% and 29%, respectively, of this segment's total sales for the year ended September 30, 2025, and 100%, 0% and 0%, respectively, of such segment's total sales for the year ended September 30, 2024.

segments.name: AI Solutions

segments.name: Insurance Business
